display.purpose: Comic titles, page H1s, section headlines.

body.purpose: Body copy, metadata, form text, UI.

label.purpose: Uppercase wide-tracked section eyebrows and labels.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for border/background state transitions on buttons, inputs, cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one crimson action on a screen — primary submit, Read First, Sign up.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-neutral-bg); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 60%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action — Save, Edit, Cancel. Neutral until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-neutral-text-2); border: 1px solid var(--color-neutral-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--color-primary); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Full-width field with hairline border; crimson border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-neutral-ink); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-neutral-bg); border: 1px solid var(--color-neutral-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-neutral-ink); transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-decorative); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-input:disabled { color: var(--color-decorative); }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.description: Uppercase bordered tag for genres; crimson when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--color-neutral-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-neutral-text-2); background: transparent; }

components.name: Genre Chip (selected)
components.description: Selected filter/edit state — crimson border + crimson text.

components.name: Comic Card Cover
components.description: 2/3 portrait cover frame; Sand fill, hairline border, crimson on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; } .ds-cover { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-neutral-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-neutral-line); border-radius: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-cover { border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-diamond { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--color-primary); } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 8px; font-family: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--color-neutral-ink); transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header nav item — neutral, Sand tint + ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-navlink { display: inline-block; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-neutral-text-2); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-navlink:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-surface) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-neutral-ink); }

narrative.overview: comic is a comic publishing platform where the reading experience is the room and everything else is quiet furniture. The visual system is an editorial print metaphor rendered for screen: warm cream paper, a single crimson voice, and a refined serif (Fraunces) carrying titles while a clean sans (Manrope) handles the body. Nothing competes with the page. Depth is suggested by hairline borders and tonal shifts, never by shadows — the surfaces are flat and confident, like a well-set magazine spread. The system is restrained and editorial: accent crimson appears sparingly, reserved for the primary action and the occasional emphasis, while thin line-colored borders do the structural work.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper background (#f8f5f3) with a single crimson accent (#9a2018); accent is rare by design.
Flat, border-driven depth — no shadows; border-line hairlines define structure.
Fraunces (serif) for display + eyebrow labels, Manrope (sans) for body and UI.
The recurring solid crimson diamond marks section titles.
A dedicated dark reader theme that strips app chrome entirely.
WCAG 2.1 AA is a hard constraint: #a4a09e is decoration-only, never text on cream.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Crimson is the only chromatic accent in the light theme and appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point — when it shows, it means 'this is the action.' Reserved decorative neutrals (#a4a09e) never carry text.

rules.name: The Reader Swap Rule
rules.body: In /read/*, the brand crimson (#9a2018) fails 2.33:1 on the dark ground, so it is swapped for Reader Crimson (#db6255), which meets AA there. The dark reader palette (#121110 bg, #1a1715 chrome, #f8f5f3 ink) replaces the cream system wholesale; no app header or footer appears.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section title is preceded by an uppercase Fraunces eyebrow (0.72rem, 0.18em tracking, crimson). It is the system's signature label treatment — never Manrope, never lowercase.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Borders (never shadows) separate and define. State changes are communicated by border-color and fill shifts, not by elevation.

dos: Do keep crimson rare — reserve it for the primary action, the diamond marker, and hover/active emphasis.
Do use border-line hairlines (not shadows) to separate and define surfaces.
Do precede every section title with the uppercase Fraunces crimson eyebrow.
Do enforce ≥16px control font and ≥28px hit targets on touch/narrow viewports.
Do swap to the dark reader theme (#db6255 accent on #121110) inside /read/* and strip all app chrome there.
donts: Don't use #a4a09e (Decorative) as text on cream — it fails AA (2.39:1); it is decoration only.
Don't introduce box-shadows or elevation to 'lift' cards/buttons; depth is border- and tone-driven.
Don't let long titles or covers stretch the layout past the viewport — keep min-w-0 on the main track.
Don't use brand crimson (#9a2018) on the dark reader ground; it fails 2.33:1 — use Reader Crimson #db6255.
Don't replace the Fraunces/Manrope pairing or the cream/crimson palette without revisiting this system.
